verdict.rationale: Abacum is a SaaS FP&A platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence shows no API reference or runnable API examples. The 'interactive demo' is a self-serve product walkthrough, which is an adjacent feature and not an API reference, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
